embeds.title: 🔴 PoC Released for DirtyDecrypt Linux Kernel Vulnerability
embeds.description:
The V12 security team released proof-of-concept code for DirtyDecrypt (aka DirtyCBC), a Linux kernel vulnerability affecting the RxGK subsystem that could allow attackers to elevate privileges to root. The vulnerability is reported to be a missing copy-on-write guard in the rxgk_decrypt_skb component that accepts oversized response authenticators, potentially writing data to privileged process memory or page cache. The underlying issue is reported to be CVE-2026-31635 with a CVSS score of 7.5, disclosed on April 24. The flaw affects distributions with CONFIG_RXGK compiled in and enabled, including Arch Linux, Fedora, and openSUSE.
